# unifi_network_network (Data Source)

Look up a single UniFi network by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a network by name (or by id) to reference its attributes elsewhere.
data "unifi_network_network" "lan" {
  name = "Default"
}

output "lan_subnet" {
  value = data.unifi_network_network.lan.subnet
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Controller object ID. Provide `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Network name. Provide `id` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `network_group` (String) Controller network group.
- `purpose` (String) Network purpose.
- `subnet` (String) Gateway IP + prefix (CIDR).
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN ID (null if untagged).
